heading: Today
text: Becoming mostly sunny south.  Morning clouds breaking for increasing sun north.  Warmer.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds south 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west, less than 10 mph east, diminishing in the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy, giving way to more clouds after midnight.  Mild.  Lows in the 50s.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Limited breaks of morning sun giving way to clouds.  Showers developing in NY south of the Adirondacks, spreading east from Rt. 4 south in the afternoon, scattered north, spotty in Quebec.  Highs 70 to 75.  Winds light and variable.
